Watts made this hymn from Psalm 94:1, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth. PSALM 94:1 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 94
